pois.name: Brisbane Arcade
pois.description: The ‘Jewel in the Crown’ of Brisbane, Brisbane Arcade is Brisbane’s oldest shopping arcade. Believed to have been under construction in 1923 with the first store openings in 1924, the arcade’s history spans nearly a century.

terminalResolution.notes: Added the Brisbane International Cruise Terminal (from OpenStreetMap), which takes most ships since 2020; Bretts Wharf is kept for smaller ships. The rest are river ferry terminals.
